title: Interleaved-batch deadlock causing quantized-serving accuracy drift and mitigations
creator: Leah Chen
description: Post-incident investigation for a production outage where interleaved batching + quantized kernel scheduling produced a deadlock-like stall that led to request timeouts and intermittent accuracy drift for several RLHF and conversational models. This ticket captures timeline, root cause analysis, immediate mitigations, and a prioritized action plan to prevent recurrence.
incident_summary: On 2026-03-03 03:14 UTC we observed a surge of 5xx timeouts and elevated latency across several hosted endpoints backed by int8-quantized model variants. A subset of requests started returning truncated or lower-quality completions (accuracy drift). The serving fleet showed a pattern of long tail queuing on batched worker threads; investigation found an interleaved-batch scheduling path that could deadlock when combined with prefix KV cache eviction and operator fallback paths.
timeline: 2026-03-03 03:14 UTC - Alerts triggered: endpoint-error-rate>5% and p99 latency spike
2026-03-03 03:16 UTC - On-call triaged; applied emergency autoscale ramp target + redirected traffic to larger non-quantized variant
2026-03-03 03:22 UTC - Initial mitigations reduced error-rate but quality anomalies persisted for remaining traffic hitting quantized pool
2026-03-03 03:45 UTC - Logs show worker threads in waiting state; core dump captured from one pod; reproduced locally with stress harness
2026-03-03 08:10 UTC - Engineering lead convened incident review; rollback of quantized kernel selector flag to safe-path completed for all clusters
2026-03-04 12:00 UTC - Canaries validating rollback reported stable latency and quality; incident declared mitigated
2026-03-05 09:00 UTC - Root cause hypothesis draft completed; this ticket created to track remediation and follow-ups
impact: Approximately 1.3% of live requests during the surge hit the buggy quantized path; affected customers included three mid-market customers with conversational workloads and two internal QA tenants. Observable effects: increased 5xxs, p99 latency degradation, and measurable NLL/QA score regressions on a curated prompt set.
root_cause: Race condition in the interleaved-batching scheduler when a batch being materialized triggered KV cache eviction concurrently with an operator fallback from fused-int8 attention to a reference kernel. The fallback path acquires a different lock ordering and can park the batch worker waiting for a resource held by another parked worker, producing a livelock/deadlock-like stall. The stalled workers created a backlog that caused timeouts and forced downstream callers to fall back to shorter context lengths, surfacing as apparent accuracy drift.
contributing_factors: Aggressive autoscaler burst created sudden distribution shift in sequence lengths and batch shapes
Insufficient locking invariants across fused-kernel fallback and kv-cache eviction code paths
Limited canary coverage: production canaries did not exercise the exact combination of long-prefix KV cache churn + operator fallback
Observability gap: thread-level wait-states and lock acquisition metrics were not exposed in the standard runtime dashboard
mitigations_performed: Immediate: Rollback kernel-selector flag to force safe (non-interleaved) scheduling for quantized variants
Traffic-routing: Shifted traffic to larger non-quantized instances and engaged emergency autoscale
Short-term: Increased kv-cache size and disabled aggressive eviction heuristics in affected clusters
Added temporary healthcheck gating on worker thread stall detection to proactively recycle pods
action_items: ENG-50877-A1: Add ordered-locking contract and assertions across fused-kernel fallback and kv-cache eviction paths (owner: Rohan Patel, est 5) - target runtime-1.22
ENG-50877-A2: Implement thread wait-state metrics and expose a 'worker stall' panel in Console runtime dashboard (owner: Maya Alvarez, est 3) - include alerts on >2% workers stalled >500ms
ENG-50877-A3: Expand canary harness to include synthetic workload that triggers long-prefix KV churn + operator fallback (owner: Sandeep Rao, est 3) - add to nightly canaries
ENG-50877-A4: Improve kernel-selector safety net: add runtime guard that detects lock inversion patterns and falls back to serialized scheduling (owner: Rohan Patel, est 5)
ENG-50877-A5: Postmortem and customer communication update; create KB article describing best practices and mitigation knobs for customers using quantized variants (owner: Priya Singh, est 2)
ENG-50877-A6: Run a model-eval regression suite against quantized path on a larger, prioritized prompt set for affected customers before re-enabling (owner: Eval Team, est 4)
testing_plan: Unit tests for new locking invariants with deterministic interleaving mocks
Integration test: reproduce interleaved-batch + kv-eviction race using stress harness in CI
Canary: phased rollout to 1% of traffic with golden prompt-set evals and worker-stall alerting enabled
Performance regression tests to ensure added guard does not increase median latency beyond 2%
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Merge locking invariant and guard; run full CI + nightly stress canary (no traffic) - target: 2026-03-16
Stage 2: Enable guarded interleaved scheduling in canary pool at 0.5% traffic with stall alerts - monitor 48h - target: 2026-03-17
Stage 3: Expand to 5% with continuous evals and rollback window - target: 2026-03-18
Stage 4: Full enable after 72h of stable canary and no regressions - target: 2026-03-20
monitoring_and_metrics: Dashboard panels: worker stall heatmap, per-pool stall rate, canary prompt-set quality delta
Alert thresholds: >1.5% workers stalled >500ms for 1m => SEV3; >3% stalled >500ms => SEV1
Introduce token-quality regression alert tied to canary prompt-set (NLL or task-specific score drop >4%)
post_incident_notes: Customer outreach: Sent initial incident summary and mitigation steps to affected accounts on 2026-03-04
Cross-team sync scheduled on 2026-03-09 with Runtime, Serving, and Eval teams to finalize test coverage
Proposed a quarterly 'chaos' scenario for quantized path that purposefully induces KV churn to validate resilience
